title: Midnight in Paris
review:
I am obsessed! Instead of a Van Gogh reference for the movie cover, I would've made the painting Dalí described in the movie, with Owen's face and Dalí's signature clocks dialing midnight. Much more related in meaning, and also referenced.

On the other hand, it is a movie that helps you understand "the golden age syndrome" to perfection, and it's just amazing to watch.
